prompt: Implement the Factory pattern: ShapeFactory.create returns a circle or square Shape depending on the kind string, or throws IllegalArgumentException for anything else.
explanation: A static factory method centralizes object creation: callers ask for a kind by name and never touch concrete classes. Because Shape has exactly one abstract method it is a functional interface, so each branch can return a lambda that captures the size parameter. Throwing IllegalArgumentException for unknown kinds fails fast instead of silently returning null.
hints: Use a switch (or if/else chain) on the kind string with cases for "circle" and "square".
Shape has a single abstract method, so a lambda works: return () -> size * size;
The default branch should throw new IllegalArgumentException(...), not return null.
